tEn: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
tZh: Gemini 2.5：以先进推理、多模态、长上下文和下一代智能体能力推动前沿
sEn: Gemini 2.5 Pro is a thinking model achieving state-of-the-art performance in coding and reasoning, while the Gemini 2.X family spans the full Pareto frontier of capability vs cost.
sZh: Gemini 2.5 Pro 是具备前沿编码与推理能力的思考模型，Gemini 2.X 系列则覆盖了能力与成本的完整帕累托前沿。
absEn: In this report, we introduce the Gemini 2.X model family: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash, as well as our earlier Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite models. Gemini 2.5 Pro is our most capable model yet, achieving SoTA performance on frontier coding and reasoning benchmarks. In addition to its incredible coding and reasoning skills, Gemini 2.5 Pro is a thinking model that excels at multimodal understanding and it is now able to process up to 3 hours of video content. Its unique combination of long context, multimodal and reasoning capabilities can be combined to unlock new agentic workflows. Gemini 2.5 Flash provides excellent reasoning abilities at a fraction of the compute and latency requirements and Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite provide high performance at low latency and cost. Taken together, the Gemini 2.X model generation spans the full Pareto frontier of model capability vs cost, allowing users to explore the boundaries of what is possible with complex agentic problem solving.
absZh: 本报告介绍了 Gemini 2.X 模型系列：Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash，以及早前的 Gemini 2.0 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 模型。Gemini 2.5 Pro 是我们迄今最强大的模型，在前沿编码和推理基准上取得了最先进的性能。除了惊人的编码和推理能力外，Gemini 2.5 Pro 还是一个擅长多模态理解的思考模型，现可处理长达 3 小时的视频内容。其长上下文、多模态和推理能力的独特结合可解锁新的智能体工作流。Gemini 2.5 Flash 以极低的计算和延迟需求提供了出色的推理能力，而 Gemini 2.0 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 则以低延迟和低成本提供高性能。总体而言，Gemini 2.X 模型系列覆盖了模型能力与成本的完整帕累托前沿，让用户能够探索复杂智能体问题解决的边界。

limits.zh: 评估开发难以跟上模型能力的快速提升，尤其是在强大的推理智能体出现之后。

limits.en: Agentic systems demand far more complex benchmarks that cover capability breadth, difficulty, and tasks with economic value.
limits.zh: 智能体式系统需要复杂得多的基准，需覆盖能力广度、难度以及具有经济价值的任务。

limits.zh: Gemini 2.5 在网络安全和机器学习研发等关键能力上显著提升，但未跨越关键能力等级。

limits.en: Within a year, Gemini Pro improved 5x on Aider Polyglot and 2x on SWE-bench verified, illustrating progress outpacing evaluation.
limits.zh: 一年内，Gemini Pro 在 Aider Polyglot 上提升 5 倍、在 SWE-bench verified 上提升 2 倍，显示出进展超越评估。

items.en: In this report, we introduce the Gemini 2.X model family: Gemini 2.5 Pro and Gemini 2.5 Flash, as well as our earlier Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite models. Gemini 2.5 Pro is our most capable model yet, achieving SoTA performance on frontier coding and reasoning benchmarks. In addition to its incredible coding and reasoning skills, Gemini 2.5 Pro is a thinking model that excels at multimodal understanding and it is now able to process up to 3 hours of video content. Its unique combination of long context, multimodal and reasoning capabilities can be combined to unlock new agentic workflows. Gemini 2.5 Flash provides excellent reasoning abilities at a fraction of the compute and latency requirements and Gemini 2.0 Flash and Flash-Lite provide high performance at low latency and cost. Taken together, the Gemini 2.X model generation spans the full Pareto frontier of model capability vs cost, allowing users to explore the boundaries of what is possible with complex agentic problem solving.
items.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍 Gemini 2.X 模型系列：Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash，以及我们早前的 Gemini 2.0 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 模型。Gemini 2.5 Pro 是我们迄今最强大的模型，在前沿编码和推理基准上取得了 SoTA 表现。除了惊人的编码和推理能力外，Gemini 2.5 Pro 还是一个擅长多模态理解的思维模型，现在能够处理长达 3 小时的视频内容。它独特的组合——长上下文、多模态和推理能力——可以结合起来，解锁新的智能体工作流。Gemini 2.5 Flash 以极低的算力和延迟需求提供了出色的推理能力，而 Gemini 2.0 Flash 和 Flash-Lite 则以低延迟和低成本提供了高性能。总的来说，Gemini 2.X 模型代际覆盖了模型能力与成本之间的完整帕累托前沿，使用户能够探索复杂智能体式问题解决的边界。

items.en: In this report we have introduced the Gemini 2.X model family: Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash and Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite. Taken together, these models span the full Pareto frontier of model capability vs cost, and Gemini 2.5 Pro is the most capable model we have ever developed. Gemini 2.5 Pro excels across a wide range of capabilities, and represents a step change in performance relative to Gemini 1.5 Pro. Its coding, math and reasoning performance are particularly notable and Gemini 2.5 Pro obtains extremely competitive scores on the Aider Polyglot evaluation, GPQA (diamond) and Humanity’s Last Exam.
items.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Gemini 2.X 模型系列：Gemini 2.5 Pro、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Gemini 2.0 Flash 和 Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite。总体而言，这些模型覆盖了模型能力与成本之间的完整帕累托前沿，而 Gemini 2.5 Pro 是我们迄今开发的最强大模型。Gemini 2.5 Pro 在广泛的能力范围内表现出色，相较于 Gemini 1.5 Pro 实现了性能的阶跃式提升。其编码、数学和推理性能尤为突出，Gemini 2.5 Pro 在 Aider Polyglot 评估、GPQA（diamond）和 Humanity's Last Exam 上均取得了极具竞争力的分数。

items.en: As well as their strong performance on academic benchmarks, entirely new capabilities are unlocked with the Gemini 2.5 models. Gemini is now the preferred AI assistant amongst educators and it is now possible for Gemini to take a video of a lecture and create an interactive web application that can test a student’s knowledge of that content. Finally, the Gemini 2.5 models enable exciting new agentic workflows, and have started to power numerous Google products already.
items.zh: 除了在学术基准上的强劲表现外，Gemini 2.5 模型还解锁了全新的能力。Gemini 现已成为教育工作者首选的 AI 助手，并且 Gemini 现在可以拍摄讲座视频并创建一个交互式 Web 应用，用于测试学生对该内容的掌握情况。最后，Gemini 2.5 模型支持令人兴奋的智能体式工作流，并已开始为众多 Google 产品提供动力。

items.en: In addition to being highly performant, the Gemini 2.5 models maintain strong safety standards and, compared to their 1.5 counterparts, are much more helpful. They are less likely to refuse to answer important user queries or respond with an overly sanctimonious tone. Gemini 2.5 exhibited notable increases in Critical Capabilities, including cybersecurity and machine learning R&D. However, the model has not crossed any Critical Capability Levels.
items.zh: 除了具有高性能之外，Gemini 2.5 模型还保持了强大的安全标准，并且与其 1.5 版本相比，更加乐于助人。它们更不可能拒绝回答重要的用户查询，或以过分说教的语气回应。Gemini 2.5 在关键能力（包括网络安全和机器学习研发）方面表现出显著提升。然而，该模型尚未跨越任何关键能力级别。

items.en: Reflecting on the path to Gemini 2.5, the staggering performance improvement attained over the space of just one year points to a new challenge in AI research: namely that the development of novel and sufficiently challenging evaluation benchmarks has struggled to keep pace with model capability improvements, especially with the advent of capable reasoning agents. Over the space of just a year, Gemini Pro’s performance has gone up 5x on Aider Polyglot and 2x on SWE-bench verified (one of the most popular and challenging agentic benchmarks). Not only are benchmarks saturating quickly, but every new benchmark that gets created can end up being more expensive and take longer to create than its predecessor, due to the more restricted pool of experts able to create it. Experts were paid up to $5000 for each question that was accepted to the Humanity’s Last Exam benchmark, and while this benchmark still has significant headroom at the time of writing (June 2025), performance on it has improved significantly over the space of a few months (with the best models achieving just a few percent accuracy on it when it was initially published in early 2025). When one considers agentic systems, which are able to tackle problems for longer and which have access to tools and self-critique, the complexity of benchmarks required to measure performance also increases dramatically. Being able to scale evaluations in both their capability coverage and their difficulty, while also representing tasks that have economic value, will be the key to unlocking the next generation of AI systems.
items.zh: 回顾通往 Gemini 2.5 的历程，仅仅一年时间所取得的惊人性能提升，指向了 AI 研究中的一项新挑战：即开发新颖且具有足够挑战性的评估基准难以跟上模型能力的提升，尤其是在能力强大的推理智能体出现之后。在短短一年内，Gemini Pro 在 Aider Polyglot 上的性能提升了 5 倍，在 SWE-bench verified（最流行且最具挑战性的智能体基准之一）上提升了 2 倍。不仅基准迅速饱和，而且每一个新创建的基准都可能比其前身更昂贵、耗时更长，因为能够创建它的专家群体更加有限。专家为 Humanity's Last Exam 基准中被接受的每个问题最多可获得 5000 美元的报酬；尽管在撰写本文时（2025 年 6 月）该基准仍有很大的提升空间，但其性能在几个月内已显著提高（该基准于 2025 年初首次发布时，最佳模型的准确率仅有几个百分点）。当考虑到能够更长时间解决问题、拥有工具和自我批判能力的智能体系统时，衡量性能所需的基准复杂度也急剧增加。能够扩展评估的能力覆盖范围和难度，同时代表具有经济价值的任务，将是解锁下一代 AI 系统的关键。

The development of Gemini is a large-scale collaborative effort involving over 3000 individuals across Google, including researchers, engineers, and operations staff. These individuals contributed their hard work and expertise across diverse areas, from foundational research and the development of model architecture, data, training, and infrastructure, through to evaluation and ensuring safety and security. We gratefully acknowledge the dedication and hard work of each contributor in making Gemini a reality. The order of contributors in the above list is random.
items.zh: Gemini的开发是一项大规模协作工作，涉及Google内超过3000名个人，包括研究人员、工程师和运营人员。这些个人在不同领域贡献了他们的辛勤工作和专业知识，从基础研究、模型架构、数据、训练和基础设施的开发，到评估以及确保安全与保障。我们衷心感谢每一位贡献者的奉献和辛勤工作，使Gemini成为现实。以上列表中的贡献者顺序是随机的。

items.en: We are also grateful to the Google-independent developer Joel Zhang for his work on Gemini Plays Pokémon, and for sharing with us the design of his set-up.
items.zh: 我们也感谢Google之外的独立开发者Joel Zhang，他开发了Gemini Plays Pokémon项目，并与我们分享了他的设置设计。
